# Task P1-01: Domain model, quality seeds and default profiles

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The Phase 1 domain tables exist in SQLite with one EF migration: songs, artists, credits, album contexts, song files, the seeded quality list, the two default quality profiles and a default library. Quality-profile cutoff logic ("is this quality allowed / at or above cutoff / an upgrade") is implemented and tested, because Wanted (Cutoff Unmet) and the decision engine build on it. No API and no repositories yet (P1-07/P1-08 add those).

## Deliverables
All entities derive from `Compilarr.Core.Persistence.EntityBase` (`Id`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`), live in namespace `Compilarr.Core.Domain`, are `sealed` classes with XML doc comments, and store enums as strings (`HasConversion<string>()`, PascalCase values, like `CommandRecord`). External ids are `string?` (MusicBrainz GUIDs stored lower-case, Spotify, YouTube) except `DeezerId` (`long?`). Table names snake_case (the naming convention does the columns).

1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/DomainEnums.cs` — `ArtistRole { Main, Featured }`, `AlbumContextKind { Album, Single, Ep, Compilation, PseudoSingles }`, `AlbumPolicy { FewestAlbums, SinglesOnly, OriginalAlbum, SingleRelease, Compilation }`, `LibraryLayout { Flat, Artist, ArtistAlbum, Plexamp }`.
2. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/Artist.cs` — table `artist`: `Name`, `SortName`, `MbArtistId?` (unique index), `SpotifyId?`, `DeezerId?`, `MonitoredTopN?` (int), `Tags` (`List<string>`, JSON).
3. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/Song.cs` — `Song` (table `song`): `Title`, `ArtistCredit` (display string, e.g. "Daft Punk feat. Pharrell Williams"), `PrimaryArtistId` (FK → artist, restrict delete), `MbRecordingId?` (unique index), `MbWorkId?`, `Isrcs` (`List<string>`), `SpotifyId?`, `DeezerId?` (unique index), `YtmVideoId?`, `DurationMs?` (int), `VersionFlags` (`List<string>`, snake_case flag names such as `radio_edit`), `Monitored` (bool, default true), `QualityProfileId` (FK), `SourceProfileId?` (long, no FK yet), `LibraryId` (FK), `AddedBy` (string: `ui`, `api`, `list:{id}`), `Tags` (`List<string>`); navigations `PrimaryArtist`, `Artists` (`List<SongArtist>`), `AlbumContext?`, `File?`. And `SongArtist` in the same file (table `song_artist`): `SongId` (FK cascade), `ArtistId` (FK restrict), `Role` (`ArtistRole`), `Position` (int); unique index (`SongId`, `Position`).
4. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/AlbumContext.cs` — table `album_context`, one row per song: `SongId` (FK cascade, **unique**), `Kind` (`AlbumContextKind`), `AlbumTitle`, `AlbumArtist`, `AlbumKey` (string, indexed: a real release MBID or a synthetic pseudo-album UUID; one per folder), `MbReleaseId?`, `MbReleaseGroupId?`, `TrackNo?`, `DiscNo?`, `TotalTracks?` (ints), `Date?` (string, `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM-DD`, identical within an `AlbumKey`), `OriginalDate?` (string), `Label?`, `CoverUrl?`, `IsVariousArtists` (bool), `Sticky` (bool, default true).
5. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/SongFile.cs` — table `song_file`, at most one per song: `SongId` (FK cascade, **unique**), `Path`, `Size` (long), `Codec`, `Container`, `BitrateKbps?`, `SampleRate?`, `BitDepth?`, `Channels?`, `DurationMs?` (ints), `QualityId` (FK → quality, restrict), `AcoustId?`, `FingerprintVerified` (bool), `SourceType` (string), `SourceRef?` (JSON text), `ImportedAt` (DateTime UTC), `TagsWritten?` (JSON text). There is deliberately **no `file_id` column on `song`**: "has a file" means a `song_file` row exists (avoids a circular FK).
6. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/Quality.cs` — `Quality` (table `quality`, seeded, ids fixed): `Name` (unique), `Group` (string, e.g. "High lossy"), `Rank` (int 1–9, the group rank), `Codec` (string: `unknown`, `mp3`, `aac`, `vorbis`, `opus`, `wma`, `flac`, `alac`, `ape`, `wavpack`, `wav`, `aiff`), `Lossless` (bool), `MinBitrate?`, `MaxBitrate?` (kbps), `BitDepth?`. Plus `QualityProfile` (table `quality_profile`): `Name` (unique), `Items` (`List<QualityProfileItem>` stored as one JSON text column), `CutoffQualityId` (FK → quality), `UpgradeAllowed`, `MinScore` (int), `DurationToleranceMs` (int); and `public sealed record QualityProfileItem(string? Name, List<long> QualityIds, bool Allowed)`. Methods on `QualityProfile` (pure, no DB):
   - `int? GroupIndexOf(long qualityId)` — index of the item containing the quality, or null;
   - `bool IsAllowed(long qualityId)`;
   - `bool MeetsCutoff(long qualityId)` — `GroupIndexOf(q) >= GroupIndexOf(CutoffQualityId)`; a quality not in the profile never meets it;
   - `bool IsUpgrade(long currentQualityId, long candidateQualityId)` — `UpgradeAllowed`, candidate allowed, and candidate's group index strictly greater than the current one's (a current quality missing from the profile counts as index −1).
   `Items` is ordered **worst → best**.
7. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/Library.cs` — table `library`: `Name` (unique), `RootPath`, `Layout` (`LibraryLayout`), `NamingTemplate`, `SidecarOptions` (JSON text, default `{}`), `AlbumPolicy`, `MinTracksPerRealAlbum` (int, default 2), `PlexSectionId?` (string), `IsDefault` (bool).
8. `src/Compilarr.Core/Domain/SeedData.cs` — `public static class SeedData` with the quality list, the two profiles and the default library exactly as in the tables below, as static arrays the configuration feeds to `HasData` (fixed `CreatedAt`/`UpdatedAt` = `2026-09-28T00:00:00Z`), plus `public const long StandardProfileId = 1, LosslessProfileId = 2, DefaultLibraryId = 1;`.
9. `src/Compilarr.Core/Persistence/DomainModelConfiguration.cs` — `internal static class DomainModelConfiguration` with `public static void Configure(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)` holding every mapping above (tables, indexes, FKs, conversions, JSON converters with `ValueComparer`s, `HasData`). `CompilarrDbContext` gets the new `DbSet`s (`Artists`, `Songs`, `SongArtists`, `AlbumContexts`, `SongFiles`, `Qualities`, `QualityProfiles`, `Libraries`) and calls `DomainModelConfiguration.Configure(modelBuilder)` at the end of `OnModelCreating`.
10. Migration `AddDomainModel` generated, never hand-written: `dotnet tool restore` then `dotnet ef migrations add AddDomainModel --project src/Compilarr.Core --startup-project src/Compilarr.Core --output-dir Persistence/Migrations`. Delete any `design.db` left behind.
11. Tests in `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Domain/`: `QualityProfileTests.cs` (cutoff logic against the seeded "Standard 320" and "Lossless" profiles) and `DomainModelPersistenceTests.cs` (real SQLite via the existing `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Persistence/SqliteTestDatabase.cs`, migrated).

## Constraints
- EF Core 10.0.12 + `EFCore.NamingConventions` 10.0.1 (already referenced). No new packages.
- `List<string>` properties: EF Core 10 maps primitive collections to a JSON text column by itself — use that (no converter needed). `List<QualityProfileItem>`: an explicit `HasConversion` with `System.Text.Json` (camelCase) **and** a `ValueComparer` that compares the serialized JSON, so edits are detected. Do not use owned types or `ToJson()` for it (they do not work with `HasData`).
- `HasData` needs explicit ids and fixed timestamps; seeded rows must be identical on every migration run.
- The existing `UtcDateTimeConverter` convention already applies to new `DateTime` properties.
- Delete behaviours exactly as listed (cascade from song to its credits/context/file; restrict elsewhere).

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. `dotnet ef migrations list --project src/Compilarr.Core --startup-project src/Compilarr.Core` lists `InitialCreate`, `AddCommands`, `AddDomainModel`.
3. After migrating a fresh database: 43 qualities with the ids and names above; profiles 1 "Standard 320" (cutoff 29) and 2 "Lossless" (cutoff 36) with their items round-tripping from JSON; library 1 is the default Plexamp library (test).
4. A song with two credited artists (main + featured), two ISRCs, version flags `["remaster"]`, an album context and a file round-trips through a new context with all values intact; deleting the song deletes its credits, album context and file but not the artists (test).
5. Unique indexes reject a second song with the same `MbRecordingId` and a second album context for the same song (tests expecting `DbUpdateException`).
6. `QualityProfileTests` (tests use the `SeedData` profiles): Standard 320 → AAC-256 (25) and MP3-320 (29) and FLAC (36) meet the cutoff, MP3-256 (23) and OPUS-160 (28) do not; OPUS-160 is allowed, Vorbis Q7 (26) and Unknown (1) are not; `IsUpgrade(28, 29)` true, `IsUpgrade(29, 25)` false (same group), `IsUpgrade(29, 36)` true, `IsUpgrade(36, 29)` false, `IsUpgrade(1, 17)` true; with `UpgradeAllowed` false nothing is an upgrade. Lossless → MP3-320 allowed but below cutoff; FLAC 24-bit (40) meets it.
